project_name: StockAI Web App - Responsive Behavior Guidance
theme: Dark Terminal / Command Center (#090d16 / #0d1322 background, neon green/cyan/amber accents, monochrome dark borders)
scope: Responsive design reflow and mobile adaptation for existing React + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui app down to 360px viewport width without altering existing dark visual identity, fonts, or colors.

responsive_breakpoints_strategy.philosophy: Mobile-First approach with Tailwind responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:, xl:, 2xl:). Grid containers and flex layouts must scale down gracefully to 360px minimum viewport width.

layout_grid_rules.mobile: Single column (grid-cols-1), stacked sections, full width containers with p-3 or p-4 horizontal padding
layout_grid_rules.tablet: Two column (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2), moderate gaps (gap-4 or gap-6), p-6 padding
layout_grid_rules.desktop: Multi-column (lg:grid-cols-3, lg:grid-cols-4, xl:grid-cols-12), expanded gaps (gap-6 or gap-8)

mobile_navigation_pattern.desktop_behavior: Fixed left sidebar (width ~256px / w-64) visible at lg (1024px) and above with all 11 navigation items.
mobile_navigation_pattern.mobile_behavior: Hidden on screens < 1024px (hidden lg:block). Replaced by a top header Hamburger button (lg:hidden) triggering a shadcn/ui Sheet or Drawer overlay.

11_item_nav_drawer.trigger_button: Icon-only button with Menu / Sliders icon, min 44x44px touch target, data-testid='mobile-nav-trigger-button'
11_item_nav_drawer.sheet_content: bg-[#090d16]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-r border-slate-800/80 w-[280px] sm:w-[320px] p-4 flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto
11_item_nav_drawer.nav_item_styling: px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono flex items-center gap-3 transition-colors min-h-[44px] hover:bg-slate-800/60 text-slate-300 hover:text-emerald-400 data-[active=true]:bg-emerald-500/10 data-[active=true]:text-emerald-400 data-[active=true]:border-l-2 data-[active=true]:border-emerald-500
11_item_nav_drawer.close_on_click: Automatically close sheet when navigation link is tapped

top_header_reflow.header_container: sticky top-0 z-40 w-full bg-[#090d16]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800/80 px-3 sm:px-6 py-2.5 flex flex-wrap lg:flex-nowrap items-center justify-between gap-2 sm:gap-4

element_stacking.left_group: Flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3. Includes Mobile Nav Trigger (lg:hidden), App Logo/Title 'StockAI', and Live IST Clock badge.
element_stacking.center_group: Symbol / Search Input bar. On mobile (<640px): width w-full order-3 sm:order-2 sm:w-64 md:w-80. Expandable or full-width search bar below title bar on mobile screens.
element_stacking.right_group: Market Status Chips (NIFTY/SENSEX, Market Open/Closed indicator) & Data Mode Pill (Mock/Live toggle). Reflows into flex-wrap with items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-3 on mobile, hiding low-priority decorative text on <400px screens while retaining key values.

strategy_1_horizontal_scroll.container_class: w-full overflow-x-auto scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-700 scrollbar-track-transparent rounded-lg border border-slate-800/80 -mx-1 sm:mx-0
strategy_1_horizontal_scroll.sticky_first_column: Optional sticky left column for Symbol / Name (left-0 z-10 bg-[#0d1322] shadow-[2px_0_5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]) on mobile for scanability.

strategy_2_card_view_fallback.card_item: bg-[#0d1322] border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-3.5 space-y-2 text-xs font-mono
strategy_2_card_view_fallback.card_row: flex justify-between items-center py-1 border-b border-slate-800/40 last:border-none

StockAnalysis.layout: Grid transition from 2-column lg:grid-cols-12 to 1-column grid-cols-1 on mobile.
StockAnalysis.symbol_search_header: Full width with compact input and quick ticker pill scroll list on sm:flex-wrap.
StockAnalysis.score_dashboard: Grid 1-col on mobile, 2-col on sm, 4-col on lg for score metric cards.
StockAnalysis.factor_lists_and_charts: Col-span-full lg:col-span-7 for charts/factor breakdown, col-span-full lg:col-span-5 for AI explanation & factor list. Stack vertically on mobile.

Backtesting.form_and_runs_layout: Grid transition: grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-12. On mobile/tablet (<1280px), form panel sits on top (xl:col-span-4), run list & details stack below (xl:col-span-8).
Backtesting.metrics_grid: 6-column metric summary (Return, Sharpe, Max DD, Win Rate, Trades, Alpha) converts to grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 on mobile/tablet.
Backtesting.trades_table: Wrapped in overflow-x-auto with touch momentum scrolling.

Research.library_and_qa_layout: 2-column layout (Library list & upload form | Q&A panel) converts to 1-column vertical stack or responsive tabbed view (Tab 1: Library & Upload, Tab 2: AI Q&A) on mobile screens (<768px).

Dashboard.ticker_strip: Flex overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar whitespace-nowrap py-2 px-1 text-xs font-mono gap-4
Dashboard.metrics_cards_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-4
Dashboard.charts_and_watchlists: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 with charts col-span-full lg:col-span-8 and feed/watchlist lg:col-span-4

Nifty50Scanner.filter_toolbar: Flex-wrap flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:gap-4 items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between bg-[#0d1322] p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/80
Nifty50Scanner.results_table: Wrapped in overflow-x-auto with sticky symbol header cell.

Portfolio.holdings_and_positions: Holdings wide table uses horizontal scroll or stacked card list on mobile; Position cards use grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3.

Evals.evals_table: overflow-x-auto container with min-w-[700px] table width.

accessibility_and_touch_targets.min_touch_target: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, tabs, select triggers, pagination buttons) MUST have minimum touch target of 44x44px or padding equivalent (p-2.5 / min-h-[44px]).
accessibility_and_touch_targets.contrast_compliance: Ensure text-slate-400 and text-slate-300 on bg-[#090d16] / bg-[#0d1322] meet WCAG AA / APCA contrast. High-contrast neon green text (#10b981 / #34d399) and alert red (#ef4444) on dark surfaces.
accessibility_and_touch_targets.data_test_id: All interactive elements (buttons, mobile nav trigger, tabs, form inputs, table rows) MUST retain or include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='mobile-nav-trigger-button', data-testid='nav-link-dashboard', etc.).
accessibility_and_touch_targets.focus_states: Retain clear focus indicator: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-slate-950.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT alter existing dark terminal color palette (#090d16 background, #0d1322 card fill, slate-800 borders, green/cyan accents).
Update frontend components (.jsx / .js) to apply responsive utility classes (hidden lg:block, block lg:hidden, grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3, etc.).
Add a mobile Drawer / Sheet trigger button in Layout.jsx top header so mobile users can open the 11-item sidebar navigation.
Wrap all data tables (Scanner, Holdings, Trades, Evals, Endpoints) inside an overflow-x-auto div container to enable smooth touch scrolling on mobile.
Reflow top header elements (Clock, Market status, Search, Data pill) into responsive flex-wrap structures to prevent layout clipping on 360px screen widths.
Ensure every modified component maintains data-testid attributes for automated testing suite compatibility.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Maintain sharp, dark command-center aesthetics without adding bright gradients or changing dark theme.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_center_everything: Keep text alignment left-aligned for data readability. Grids reflow cleanly from desktop multi-column to mobile single-column.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Use specific transition target properties (transition-colors, transition-opacity, transition-transform). DO NOT use transition-all.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.touch_targets: Enforce 44x44px minimum touch target size for touch interaction on mobile devices.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_test_id: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, and table controls MUST include data-testid attributes.
